fields.mechanism: Fluidic occlusion of a conduit causing time‑dependent ischemic (biological) damage downstream.
fields.intervention: Integrate a dual‑mode sensor in the infusion line that simultaneously measures pressure drop (fluidic) and rapid optical detection of dissolved oxygen (biological) to flag occlusion as soon as flow ceases and oxygen levels fall.
fields.expected_effect: Occlusion is identified within seconds rather than minutes, satisfying the required safety interval and preventing delayed infusion or patient harm.
fields.falsification_test: In a benchtop model, create a controlled downstream blockage and compare the time to alarm between the dual‑mode sensor and the pump’s existing pressure‑only alarm; a statistically significant reduction in detection time validates the mechanism.
